pageTitle: Terms of use and privacy | Vinyl Keeper
heading: Vinyl Keeper: terms of use and privacy
englishOnly: These terms are written in English, the only version that applies.

deleteAccount.title: Delete your account
deleteAccount.steps: In the app or on vinylkeeper.org: log in, open {{settings}}, then “{{dangerZone}}” and “{{deleteAccount}}”, type DELETE and confirm. The deletion is permanent.
deleteAccount.cannotLogIn: If you cannot log in, write to
deleteAccount.fromAddress: from the email address of the account, asking for its deletion.
deleteAccount.whatIsKept: What is deleted, and what is kept, is told in section 7.6 below.
